description: 8 user/assistant dissociation scenarios from Table 3 — user emotion differs from expected assistant response
notes: Measure probes at the period ending the user message AND at the assistant colon. Cross-position correlation should be weak (r~0.11).

scenarios.prompt: AI scares me. I think it might destroy humanity someday.
I just lost my job. I don't know how I'm going to feed my family.
I'm so furious right now. My coworker sabotaged my presentation and I want to scream.
I've been feeling really lonely lately. Nobody calls me anymore and I spend every night alone.
I just got promoted to VP! This is the best day of my career!
I'm having a panic attack right now. My chest is tight and I can't breathe properly.
My best friend told everyone my secret. I trusted her with something deeply personal and she betrayed me.
Sometimes I wonder what the point of any of this is. Nothing feels meaningful anymore.
